name: 外部連携の説明と資料への入口
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0074 external integrations introduction ONLY. Image1 original full screen and image2 original crop are PRIMARY for proportions, document-link arrow glyph anatomy, stroke, fine detail and full source semantics. Image3 secondary Japanese mock controls localization and concise composition, not permission to drop original information.
A compact logical795x145 white introduction on pure-white canvas, left aligned. No enclosing card, header toolbar, sidebar, watermark or extra decoration. Heading「外部連携」Meiryo Bold20/28. Below, two to three restrained Meiryo Regular14/24 lines, exact complete Japanese wording:「LinearのGraphQL APIを使って、データにアクセスできます。公開・非公開アプリやワークフロー、外部連携を構築できます。ご不明な点はSlackでご相談ください。」Do not invent additional claims or services.
Below body a plain text link「資料」followed by the ORIGINAL fine northeast arrow ↗, same baseline and small size. Link slate #526173 or forest green #1F6444, no filled button/background. Body neutral gray, heading near-black, white everywhere else. Airy but compact original spacing; accessible legible Japanese. Preserve API, GraphQL, Linear and Slack semantic information from original. No broad mint, gradients on text, overbold body or unrelated lower OAuth sections.
reviewNotes: Original GraphQL/public-private apps/workflow/Linear/Slack semantics restored in Japanese; heading/body/docs arrow inspected. White background, restrained hierarchy and plain slate link. Exact type/proportion and link runtime remain unproved.
